buyer_requirement: Record purchase order, style, color, size range, lot quantity, packing completion, inspection location, and unit being counted
evidence_required: Order, packing, carton, and location record

buyer_requirement: State the agreed sampling standard, edition, inspection level, sampling scheme, and any switching rules
acceptance_rule: Record the resulting sample and accept or reject criteria
evidence_required: Authorized standard and released inspection instruction

buyer_requirement: Record the agreed AQL or alternative acceptance rule separately for critical, major, and minor classifications
acceptance_rule: State the rule for each defect class

buyer_requirement: Define how cartons, colors, sizes, and units will be selected across the completed lot
acceptance_rule: State minimum coverage or stratification rules

buyer_requirement: Garment, label, polybag, SKU, roster, and carton data must match the released order
approved_reference: Purchase order, SKU file, roster, and approved labels
acceptance_rule: Match the released order and data files
evidence_required: Unit photos, scan results, and data comparison

buyer_requirement: Material identity, handfeel, construction, print or dye lot, shade, opacity, stretch, recovery, and trims must match approved references
approved_reference: Approved coded swatch, material specification, lab dip or strike-off, and garment
inspection_method: Visual comparison, measurement, and agreed tests
acceptance_rule: State tolerance, visual standard, and test requirement
evidence_required: Lot ID, comparison photos, and measured or test result

buyer_requirement: Measure the required sample by size using the documented method and tolerance
approved_reference: Approved size chart, measurement diagram, tolerance table, and size-set sample
acceptance_rule: Each point must meet the released tolerance rule
evidence_required: Completed measurement sheet with unit and size IDs

buyer_requirement: Check seam type, reinforcement, skipped stitches, open seams, puckering, symmetry, panel alignment, and edge finish
approved_reference: Tech pack, workmanship standard, approved sample, and first production reference
acceptance_rule: State acceptable workmanship and defect examples
evidence_required: Defect photos with unit ID, location, and repeated pattern

buyer_requirement: Check artwork revision, size, placement, color, adhesion, registration, embroidery, names, numbers, and sponsor data
approved_reference: Approved artwork proof, placement sheet, decoration sample, and roster
inspection_method: Visual comparison, measurement, and agreed tests
acceptance_rule: State placement tolerance, finish standard, and data-match rule
evidence_required: Measurements, photos, test results, and roster comparison

buyer_requirement: Check closures, pockets, drawcords, elastic recovery, pads, reversible construction, and other specified functions
approved_reference: Tech pack, component standard, approved sample, and functional method
acceptance_rule: State the required action, cycle, or pass condition
evidence_required: Unit-level functional result and failure evidence

buyer_requirement: Check care, fiber, country, brand, size, tracking, barcode, and other buyer-approved market information
approved_reference: Approved label artwork, compliance brief, SKU file, and placement specification
acceptance_rule: Match released content, placement, legibility, and scan rule
evidence_required: Label photos, content comparison, and scan result

buyer_requirement: Check folding, polybag, insert, size sticker, barcode, player pack, SKU assortment, and quantity
approved_reference: Approved packing reference, SKU file, roster, and order breakdown
acceptance_rule: Match released pack-out and assortment rules
evidence_required: Pack photos, count, scan, and data reconciliation

buyer_requirement: Check carton dimensions, marks, assortment, gross and net data, sealing, condition, and packing-list reconciliation
approved_reference: Carton plan, shipping marks, order specification, and packing list
inspection_method: Visual, count, measurement, and document comparison
acceptance_rule: Match released carton and shipment rules
evidence_required: Carton photos, dimensions, weight, count, and reconciliation

buyer_requirement: Record unit ID, style, size, color, location, description, photo, classification, repeated pattern, and related requirement
approved_reference: Defect classification guide and approved specification
acceptance_rule: Apply the released class and counting rule
evidence_required: Numbered photos and unit-level defect record

buyer_requirement: Record sampled quantity, defect counts by class, acceptance decision, corrective action, rework scope, reinspection need, approver, and release status
approved_reference: Inspection agreement, report, and buyer release procedure
acceptance_rule: Apply the released decision plan and exception authority
evidence_required: Signed report, corrective evidence, reinspection, and written release
